You have one course below the 75% minimum attendance requirement: **CS301 Database Management Systems** with an attendance percentage of 66.9 [SQL]. A student must have at least 75% attendance in each registered course to take the end-semester examination [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2].

The shortfall in **CS301 Database Management Systems** can be condoned [SQL]. Because your attendance is 66.9%, which falls into the range of **at least 65% but below 75%**, the shortfall may be condoned on medical or other documented grounds [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3]. 

To receive condonation, you must meet the following conditions:
* Submit a condonation application with supporting documents (e.g., a medical certificate) to the Head of Department [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
* Pay a condonation fee of ₹500 [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
* Request condonation before the last teaching day of the term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
* Note that a student may receive condonation in at most two courses per term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3]. 

If attendance falls below 65% or a condonation request is rejected, you will be detained in the course and unable to take its end-semester examination [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4].
sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.title, e.attendance_pct FROM (SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE student_id = 'S2024CS006') AS e JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S2024CS006' AND e.attendance_pct < 75 ORDER BY e.attendance_pct ASC LIMIT 50
